tui.chrome.bindings.legend_app_ctrl_b: show or hide the sessions list
tui.chrome.bindings.legend_app_ctrl_home: jump to the transcript top or end
tui.chrome.bindings.legend_app_ctrl_n_ct: start a new session / resume one
tui.chrome.bindings.legend_app_ctrl_t: expand or collapse the todo panel
tui.chrome.bindings.legend_sessions_ctrl: show or hide the ⌥ subagent runs
jump to the first subagent run
tui.chrome.bindings.legend_sessions_ente: open the row under the cursor
tui.chrome.bindings.legend_sessions_f9: enter the list; f9 again returns
tui.chrome.bindings.legend_sessions_up_d: move the cursor; pageup/pagedown, home/end jump
